items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: The Sergeant Blake. And I'll forget that man. He said, look here boy. Look if you bleed. ... He rushed me back to the hospital.

ctx.x: After the massacre creed, they had a... We was afraid then we would take no chances. And the call went for us to settle. And he was up in a big old Spanish building. And a whole gang of... All of us tried to get out the same do. All of us tried to get out the same do. And some fellow, by fixing his bed, that bed is sharp. He stuck me there. And I didn't know I was cut until I was halfway... I was a mile in the mountain running. Trying to catch... To get that captain out of the jam. And I looked down and saw that…
I don't see how it's possible that you don't have a service record in Washington.
